SELECT player_id, player_name, COUNT(*) AS double_doubles
FROM (
  SELECT player_id, player_name,
    (CASE WHEN pts >= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
     CASE WHEN reb >= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
     CASE WHEN ast >= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
     CASE WHEN stl >= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
     CASE WHEN blk >= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cat_count
  FROM "nba_golden"."dev"."player_game_stats"
  WHERE played = 1
    AND CAST(strftime('%Y', game_date) AS INTEGER) = 2017
) t
WHERE cat_count >= 2
GROUP BY player_id, player_name
ORDER BY double_doubles DESC, player_name ASC
LIMIT 500
